brief: Cleaning operations management for SCHNELL & SAUBER TAHA AL NUAIMI in Vienna. Manager: Sonja. Three-tier architecture: owner app (Sonja's full management), worker app (5 employees, light), client app (public QR for service requests). Stack: Vite + React + TypeScript + Supabase PostgreSQL.

prd.overview: Cleaning operations app for one Austrian cleaning company. Sonja runs the business.
goals: Sonja runs entire business from one app
Payroll automated from clock in/out + digital signature receipt
Customer requests via QR scan, no app install

tech_spec.auth: Email + password via Supabase Auth (Sonja: sonja@taha.at)
tech_spec.database: PostgreSQL — 16 tables, RLS, payroll RPC, idempotent schema

mcp_usage.mcp-blueprint: Gates this and future projects (12-step build flow)
mcp_usage.mcp-storage: Receipt PDFs, building images, payroll PDFs
mcp_usage.mcp-notifications: Payroll receipts, schedule changes, low stock alerts
mcp_usage.mcp-analytics: Clock-in events, expense events, signature events
mcp_usage.mcp-monitor: Uptime monitoring on client public URL

mcp_excluded.mcp-billing: No payment flows in Taha v1
mcp_excluded.mcp-search: Dataset too small to need indexed search
mcp_excluded.mcp-user-mgmt: Supabase Auth handles user lifecycle directly

user_stories: As Sonja, I create the weekly schedule and employees see shifts instantly
As Sonja, I reassign a sick employee in under 5 minutes
As employee, I clock in at the building and clock out when done
As Sonja, I review payroll on Friday and send payslips with one click
As employee, I sign my payslip digitally to confirm receipt
As employee, I report low bleach stock and Sonja sees it immediately
As customer, I scan QR, fill form, request cleaning in under 2 minutes
As customer, I see Sonja's name and phone with one tap to call
